tool: OpenAI Codex authored deterministic Three.js geometry; GLTFExporter writes local GLB files. No image-to-3D service or third-party model used.

sources.usedFor: July 1997 landing press kit, printed pages 7 and 28-32: rover dimensions, 13cm wheel diameter, component schematics, three-petal structure, deployed 2.75m span and camera mast about 1.5m.
Rover hardware photograph, six-wheel rocker-bogie architecture, solar array, rear APXS, antenna and broad hardware arrangement.
Independent mission photograph for comparing real rover hardware.

models.classification: AI-assisted authored educational reconstruction based on NASA references; not a NASA-issued model or engineering CAD.
models.limitations: Solar cell pattern, wheel cleats, joints, wiring, antenna length and material appearance are approximate. Main body proportion and six 13cm wheels follow NASA references. No internal engineering mechanisms reconstructed.

models.classification: AI-assisted authored educational reconstruction based on NASA references; not a NASA-issued model or engineering CAD.
models.limitations: Open-petal educational state, rover separate. Airbags, discarded arrival hardware, internal mechanisms and minute wiring omitted. Petal geometry, instrument arrangement and optical materials simplified. 2.75m overall horizontal span used as a reference; no claim to photogrammetric fidelity.
